description: This file defines controller functions for managing 'tools' in a web application, including create, delete, retrieve, and update operations, using Express.js request handlers.

methods.name: createTool
methods.description: Handles creation of a new tool, validating request body and user organization/workspace IDs.

methods.name: deleteTool
methods.description: Handles deletion of a tool by ID, validating request parameters and workspace ID.

methods.name: getAllTools
methods.description: Retrieves all tools with pagination, based on user's active workspace.

methods.name: getToolById
methods.description: Fetches a specific tool by ID within the user's active workspace.

methods.name: updateTool
methods.description: Updates an existing tool by ID, validating request parameters and body.
